source_conclusions: The wide observer adds only the fixed WideFromBlocks/WideToBlocks labels and one-child inventory traversal; these are not treated as transparent lineage conversions.

Direct scalar ownership uses exact lambda-argument identity. Local NarrowMap bijections require one AsStruct body,1..128 own arguments, unique decoded output names and exact one-time use of every argument.

Local bijection and branch-input ownership remain independent counters: foreign inputs, unknown wrappers, malformed arity and depth limits can coexist with a locally bijective projection without granting proof.

All new output names are fixed/allowlisted categories and bounded counts; raw field names, symbols, constants and graph nodes stay in RAM. The old broad other_computation category remains intentionally overlapping for comparison and must not be interpreted as proof of computation.

The separate proof-stage guard creates a fresh tuple-identity set inside each stage traversal. It preserves callable-node deduplication, nested-stage boundaries, stage discovery and every proof predicate/result field.
Shared programs remain independently traversed for each stage. Graph ownership keeps reachable tuple identities stable while each set is used.

The wrapper changes only its version, retaining all functions, exact two24-row profiles, source snapshots, schema/fixture/row oracle delegation, enabled sharing, node spill mask and one-byte local storage cap.

The new observer keeps all four proof/admission flags false. Existing proof semantics and historical evidence remain unchanged; no new shared-producer or aggregate-value lineage acceptance is created.
All six pinned production API/source hashes were independently checked; observed unknown block wrapper identity remains a hypothesis until the new bounded observations.
limits: The tuple change establishes a distinct-object bound for one discovery traversal; it does not claim every helper operation is globally linear.
Only the same two24-row cells are ready for root-coordinated guarded observations after idle application.
Native semantic/structural success and direct33 evidence stay separate from complete shared-field lineage, which remains pending.
Do not reinterpret old broad counters or source-supported wrapper hypotheses as runtime lineage proof.
